title: minuartia tenuifolia subsp. conferta
intro: Minuartia tenuifolia subsp. conferta, commonly known as Alpine Rock-cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic to promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Alpine Rock-cress is rich in vitamin C and other nutrients, making it a valuable medicinal plant for treating various health conditions.
